entries.claim: Documents and Application Support are backed up by default; Documents contents included in iTunes/iCloud; NSURLIsExcludedFromBackupKey provides exclusion.
entries.applicability: Current iOS legacy path explicitly uses Documents/snapshots while exclusion calls apply only to protected Application Support tree/files. Historical 9d06 first-party implementation created raw bytes there.
entries.limitation: Archived authoritative directory guide, not proof a current real device backed up any data or that backup contents are publicly readable/plaintext at transport level.
